subject: Re: Partnership Proposal Confirmation
body:

Thank you for your company's interest in working with us. Attached is our revised partnership proposal. The main changes are as follows:

1. Technical support response time adjusted to 4 hours
2. Added quarterly business review meetings
3. 15% discount on service fees

If you have any questions, please feel free to get in touch.

Zhang Xia

subject: Code Review Feedback
body:
Zhixing:

I reviewed your submitted PR #125. The overall implementation looks good; I have a few suggestions:

1. In UserService.java, line 45, consider extracting this as a constant.
2. Unit tests for exception handling are missing.
3. The log level needs to be adjusted: change info to debug.

It can be merged after these changes.

Zhang Xia
